text:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout rev-2026-03-16-02 -> prod (feature: encrypt-at-rest)
Priya Singh: heads-up: canary in us-west-2 reporting 500s on model startup. stack shows KMS AccessDenied on decrypt. canary traffic ~4%.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: infra-sre on-call (high) — spike in 500s for /v1/infer (canary). Incident INC-2026-0316-02
Dan O'Rourke: I'm taking it. Priya, paste the exact error/log lines?
Priya Singh: log dump: 
```
2026-03-16T02:14:07Z runtime[infer]: ERROR decrypt model-key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/redwood-exec is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555666777:key/ghij-9012
    at KMSService.decrypt (/opt/runtime/kms-client.js:116:21)
```
Priya Singh: quick triage: REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ARN on canary is pointing to account 555666777 key; role redwood-exec in deploy account 111222333 doesn't have Decrypt granted.
Nate Park: classic cross-account KMS miss. Since decrypt is done on cold-start, canary sees failures immediately. No fail-open path for key decrypts.
Javier Morales: mitigation plan: flip feature flag to stop canary using the new encryption path, pause rollout, then rollback if needed. I can flip now.
Priya Singh: Javier flipped encrypt-at-rest -> false at 02:17 UTC (API call: `PATCH /api/flags/encrypt-at-rest {"enabled": false}`) — audit: jmorales. routing reverted to previous codepath.
deploy-bot: Canary routing reverted due to feature-flag change. error rate on KMS decrypt drops to near 0 in the stream.
Dan O'Rourke: starting rollback of rev-2026-03-16-02 to rev-2026-03-16-00. ETA ~5m.
Emma Li: collecting customer impact — Priya can you quantify affected customers and duration?
Priya Singh: query results: approx 1.9k failed requests over 9 minutes. ~0.9% of global token requests in that window. Impact concentrated on Dedicated tenants pinned to us-west-2 and two Private deployments that route to canary — roughly 14% of their request volume. Affected customers: 8 Dedicated tenants, 2 Private.
incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled in 20m to Olivia Chen per rota.
Nate Park: remediation options for safe re-deploy: ask key owner (acct 555666777) to either update key policy to allow arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-exec Decrypt, or create a grant: 
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id ghij-9012 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-exec \
  --operations Decrypt
```
Also need key policy to allow the caller to call CreateGrant.
Javier Morales: contacting key-owner ops now. Creating follow-up Jira INC-2026-0316-02-RM to track: key-policy/grant, CI gate, linter, runbook, customer comms.
Dan O'Rourke: rollback complete at 02:22 UTC. health checks green. marking incident mitigated for public traffic; keeping incident open for RCA and follow-up tasks.
Emma Li: drafting tenant advisory: short summary + impact window + actions taken (feature flag kill, rollback) + expected timeline for safe re-deploy. Will circulate to CSMs/Sales for review.
Priya Singh: confirming post-rollback: no new KMS AccessDenied entries. attaching logs and failing request IDs to the incident ticket.
Nate Park: suggested permanent fixes: 1) add a CI pre-canary gate that, for any envs containing `*_KMS_KEY_*` or `*_KMS_KEY_ARN`, attempts a `kms:Decrypt` of a test ciphertext using the task role via sts:assume-role. Block canary traffic if Decrypt fails. 2) add a deploy-linter rule: if KMS key account != deploy account, block unless explicit cross_account_kms=true.
Javier Morales: also adding runbook update: if canary has crypto-related 500s, flip flag first, then rollback; include exact API commands and escalation steps.
Olivia Chen: I'll take postmortem ownership and follow-ups. scheduling a postmortem review with infra-sre and security next week.
Emma Li: customer comms sent at 02:40 UTC to affected tenants; internal sync posted to #customer-success and #sales-ops. severity P2.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0316-02 status: mitigated -> monitoring. owner: Olivia Chen. Close when postmortem uploaded.
Javier Morales: next steps assigned in INC-2026-0316-02-RM: 1) confirm grant or key-policy change with key owner; 2) implement CI Decrypt gate; 3) implement linter rule blocking implicit cross-account KMS usage; 4) update runbook + deploy docs; 5) schedule test re-deploy after owner confirms grant. ETA for safe re-deploy: 2026-03-17 20:00 UTC (pending owner).
Dan O'Rourke: handing off to Olivia for follow-ups. I'm available if escalation needed. :white_check_mark:
Olivia Chen: ack, taking ownership. will upload draft postmortem to /confluence/incidents/INC-2026-0316-02 by EOD tomorrow.
